title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before we know it, it's time for the Japanese Derby. Fuji Kiseki is courteous to the reporters crowding her for quotes and entertains them with humor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The audience's expectations for her are high, and the younger student watches with mixed feelings. Fuji Kiseki carries all their emotions upon her shoulders as she enters the race.
